on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml

jobs:

  copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:

        id: set-up-homebrew
